quests.title: A Place to Rebuild
quests.summary: Create an isolated home for the damaged village services.
quests.intro: The village is in chaos. Before anything can be rebuilt, the quartermaster needs a safe district where the recovery work can begin.
quests.hint: Kubernetes groups related resources inside namespaces.
quests.success: A new boundary forms around the village. The rebuilding effort finally has a home.
quests.done: The district you founded is thriving. Every ledger I file now has a home.

quests.title: Light the First Lantern
quests.summary: Bring the first village service online as a Pod.
quests.intro: The new district is empty and dark. The innkeeper asks you to bring up a small nginx service so the village has its first working shelter.
quests.hint: A Pod can run a container and expose a container port.

objectives.text: Create a Pod named inn-lantern in namespace village using nginx.
Expose container port 80 on the Pod.

quests.success: Warm light spills from the inn. For the first time since the disaster, villagers gather indoors again.
quests.done: The lantern you lit still burns. Travellers find the inn every night.

quests.title: Build Something That Survives
quests.summary: Replace the fragile one-off Pod with a managed Deployment.
quests.intro: One lantern is not enough. The engineer warns that a single failure could throw the village back into darkness.
quests.hint: Deployments keep the desired number of application replicas running.

objectives.text: Create a Deployment named inn in namespace village using nginx.
Run 1 replica of the inn Deployment.

quests.success: The inn is now maintained by the village watch. If one worker falls, another can take its place.
quests.done: The watch keeps the inn standing without me touching a thing. Fine work.

quests.title: The Night Rush
quests.summary: Scale the inn to handle the returning population.
quests.intro: Refugees arrive after sunset. One inn worker cannot serve everyone, and the queue stretches through the square.
quests.hint: A Deployment can be scaled without rebuilding it from scratch.

objectives.text: Scale the inn Deployment to 3 replicas.

quests.success: Three crews work in parallel. The queue disappears and the village square comes alive again.
quests.done: Three crews, no queue. The night rush is just a story we tell now.

quests.title: Open the Road
quests.summary: Give villagers a stable route to the inn replicas.
quests.intro: The inn has three crews now, but villagers do not know which door will still exist tomorrow. A stable road is needed.
quests.hint: A Service provides a stable network endpoint for a changing set of Pods.

objectives.text: Create a Service named inn-service in namespace village that targets the inn workload on port 80.

quests.success: A permanent road sign appears in the square. Villagers can now find the inn no matter which crew is serving them.
quests.done: The road holds. Doors change, the sign does not.

quests.title: The Missing Ledger
quests.summary: Restore configuration without baking it into the application image.
quests.intro: The inn is running, but the rebuilt staff have forgotten the village greeting. The archivist insists that configuration belongs in a ledger, not inside the workers themselves.
quests.hint: ConfigMaps separate non-secret configuration from container images.

objectives.text: Create a ConfigMap named inn-config in namespace village with GREETING=WelcomeHome.

quests.success: The greeting returns to the inn ledger. The workers can change their message without being rebuilt.
quests.done: The ledger is safe in the archive, outside the workers. As it should be.

quests.title: Boss: Restore the Village
quests.summary: Prove that the village stack is healthy as one complete system.
quests.intro: The storm returns. This time the village must survive without a hero holding every piece together by hand.
quests.hint: Check desired replicas, ready replicas, Service routing and the configuration resources together.
quests.success: The storm passes. The village remains online. Chapter 1 is complete.
quests.done: The village stood through the storm because of you. This chapter of our history is written.
